newsitem.title: UK: HK stocks in London mostly flat but banks ease.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks in London mostly flat but banks ease.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London were mostly steady, with falls in banking stocks providing the session's only feature, dealers said.

Shares in HSBC Holdings fell HK$4.00 to close at HK$258.00 while Hang Seng Bank Ltd 0011q.L dropped 25 cents to HK$101.25, as the possibly of a speculative attack on the Hong Kong dollar continued to weigh on the sector.
Elsewhere, trading volume was thin, with most stocks remaining around their Hong Kong closing levels.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index eased 105.89 points to finish at 15,371.37 after the Hang Seng index tumbled 619.62 to 15,477.26, its biggest fall since March 11,1996.

Dealers said investors in London were cautious after falls in the last two sessions in Hong Kong and were looking to the outcome of the Federal Open Market Committee due at 1815 GMT to provide a lead.
-- Andrew Langlands, London Newsroom +44 171 542 4026 (c) Reuters Limited 1997
